'''''Klasea''''' is a [[genus]] of [[Eurasian]] and [[North Africa]]n flowering plants in the tribe [[Cardueae]] within the family [[Asteraceae]].<ref name=POWO/><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40035753 Tropicos, ''Klasea'' Cass.]</ref><ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=117146 Flora of China Vol. 20-21 Page 180 <big>麻花头属</big> ma hua tou shu ''Klasea'' Cassini in F. Cuvier]</ref>
